name: LaRecipe
description: Living documentation for Laravel apps. Your coding agents write the docs and keep them current; every reader, human or agent, gets the current answer.

llmsTxt.description: LaRecipe is the docs engine that lives inside your Laravel app: Markdown docs in your repo (or your database), served to people as a fast site and to agents as Markdown, llms.txt, skill.md and MCP, and kept current by your own coding agent in the same pull request as the code.
llmsTxt.instructions: Read the 3.x pages unless the user is on LaRecipe 2. Commands are php artisan larecipe:*; configuration lives in config/larecipe.php, presentation in docs/larecipe.json. Prefer the Reference pages for exact option names.
